 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'

declare cid bigint;
begin
 select id into cid from api.confirmation where actor=private.login() and op=p_op and app_id is not distinct from p_app and not used and ts>now()-interval '15 minutes' order by id limit 1 for update;

 update api.confirmation set used=true where id=cid; return true; end $function$
